provenance.constructionPolicy: Source-aligned editorial adaptation of Perseus Beheads Medusa based only on the linked source-audited record; not a source edition.

scope.beginning: The episode begins when the slaying of Medusa is selected as the heroic deed Perseus will undertake.
scope.ending: It ends when Athena guides Perseus to cut off Medusa's head and he places it in his wallet.
scope.boundaryRationale: The production unit follows only actions stated in the linked Berens record; the reflective shield, sleeping Gorgons, Pegasus, Chrysaor, and an escape sequence are excluded.

variant.chosenVersion: Berens' concise Medusa expedition: Hermes and Athena guide Perseus, and Athena guides the beheading.
materialAlternatives: Reflective-shield tactics and births from Medusa's body are not included because they are absent from the linked record.

characters.name: Medusa
characters.role: Gorgon selected as the quest target
characters.goal: remain the dangerous object of the expedition

characters.name: Athena
characters.goal: guide the expedition and the beheading

characters.name: Hermes
characters.goal: guide Perseus toward the distant region

characters.name: Polydectes
characters.role: king who promotes the heroic quest
characters.goal: send Perseus toward a deed of renown

relationships.rationale: Athena guides Perseus in the linked source.
Hermes guides Perseus on the expedition.

narrative.synopsis: Polydectes directs Perseus toward the slaying of Medusa as a deed of renown. Perseus begins the expedition under the guidance of Hermes and Athena; Athena then guides him as he cuts off Medusa's head and places it in his wallet.
narrative.openingSituation: Perseus is encouraged to distinguish himself through a great heroic deed.
narrative.centralConflict: The chosen deed is the slaying of the Gorgon Medusa in a far-off region.
narrative.resolution: Guided by Athena, Perseus cuts off Medusa's head.
narrative.outcome: Perseus places Medusa's head in his wallet; later uses of the head belong to other episodes.

events.consequence: The slaying of Medusa is chosen as the deed that will bring Perseus renown.
Perseus starts the journey toward the Gorgon.
Hermes helps guide Perseus to the far-off region.
Athena guides Perseus at the decisive moment.
Perseus cuts off Medusa's head and places it in his wallet.

visualBeats: Polydectes points Perseus toward the Medusa quest.
Hermes and Athena guide the hero through a remote landscape.
Athena guides the beheading and Perseus secures the head in his wallet.
productionNotes: Do not show a reflective shield, Pegasus, Chrysaor, sleeping Gorgons, or an escape sequence as facts from this linked record.
